name: Bug Report

### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected Behaviour
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots or Error Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or paste scrubbed diagnostic logs (from Settings > Data) to help explain your problem. Note: Kinora never logs stream URLs or credentials.

### Platform and Environment
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS Sequoia 15.1, Fedora 41, Ubuntu 24.04]
- Kinora Version: [e.g. 0.1.0 (found in Settings > About)]
- Distribution Type: [e.g. RPM, DEB, AppImage, NSIS Installer, Portable]
- Webview / Runtime: [e.g. WebKitGTK 2.44+, WebView2, Safari/WebKit]

### Media / Source Information (if applicable)
- Source Type: [e.g. M3U playlist, Xtream Codes, XMLTV guide]
- Stream Type: [e.g. HLS (.m3u8)]
- Note: Do NOT share private stream URLs, tokens, or credentials in this issue.

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here.
